If Absolute Zero was the source of the hazard attack then he would need line of sight and range would be from AZ to the target.

Impaling structures create the hazard spaces, they deal the attack.

Just like Tornado is the source of the attack for the hazard spaces it creates, not Ra.

Ra and Operative are the source of the hazard spaces and the attack for their hazard spaces.  Just like Turret bot creates its own attack and traps create their own attacks.

 

I don't know if Ra or AZ can be damaged by their structures/tornado, but I think they aren't due to that card still being their power.
